name: Oasis Find
description: Root-confined filesystem search for agents: fs_glob (find files by name), fs_grep (find files by content), fs_help (which search tool to use when). Read-only, refuses secret-shaped files, and cannot escape the bot's configured roots.

contracts._doc: REQUIRED for agent-tool exposure (openclaw 2026.7.1 plugins/tools.ts:566-634): registerTool'd tools materialize ONLY if declared here. This is HALF the gate — tools.alsoAllow must ALSO re-admit them past tools.profile='coding' (CLAW-082). Keep in sync with the api.registerTool names in index.ts.

roots.description: Absolute directories the bot may search. Overridden by OASIS_FIND_ROOTS.

denyGlobs.description: Basename globs never listed or read. Defaults mirror reviewer-policy.json hard.fleet.denyReadGlobs.

denyDirs.description: Directory names skipped during the walk (includes pliny and noise trees).
